checks.text: No real-space fit asks the box to make ripples (each model is truncated as its data are).
xpdf: fitted in r, but RMCProfile transforms the model F(Q) exactly as the data: both carry the same ripples, so the box is not asked to make them.

xpdf: r-resolution: ripples repeat every 0.233 Å (2π/Q_max, Q_max = 26.98 Å⁻¹); a peak at r₀ has its ripples near r₀ ± (n + ½)·0.116 Å (n = 1, 2, …; π/Q_max), their sign set by the peak's width; features closer than the kernel's FWHM, 0.138 Å, are not resolved.
xray_sq: fitted in Q: the box is not asked to make ripples (a G(r) transformed from these data still shows them).

data.verdict: No real-space fit asks the box to make ripples (each model is truncated as its data are).
next: This check does not say whether a given peak or shoulder is a ripple. To test one: a ripple moves with Q_max and a real feature stays, so compare a G(r) transformed with a higher Q_max, a Lorch-windowed transform (which suppresses ripples) or the other radiation's data (another Q_max).
